questions: Does V Hausdorff (with Déf. 2's 3°) force the base B = V/ℝ⁺ to be Hausdorff? Not proved here; sufficient: the ℝ₊* action is proper (t2Space_of_properSMul). It matters for Déf. 3's « topologiquement trivial » (a section forces B Hausdorff: t2Space_of_section) and for wave 4's equivalence (F(B) is Hausdorff only over Hausdorff B). A naive counterexample (W = {x>0} ⊂ ℝ²−0 modulo diag(2,½)) violates 3°, which is what excludes it.
Indexing: the cone is RnO (n+1), the base S n (Benzecri's n and n−1); GU(n+1) → GS(n) is QuotientGroup.mk, the inverse of isoGU.
